page.overview:
Who is Apple Pie?

was an automaton member of the Division of Public Benefit, an adventuring party with Fresh Cut Grass and Dancer.

Apple Pie had a relatively simple set of responsibilities for the Division.

Apple Pie may have been slightly smaller or wider than Fresh Cut Grass.

Dancer created Apple Pie, who—like all of Dancer's automaton creations—was named after one of Dancer's favorite smells.
